propositions: Type-tier comparability allows cross-subtree blocking links to escalate incorrectly to epic roots, leaving child-to-child edges unwritten (bug 1803-df54-18bb-4881)
Redundancy guard evaluates the original pair before promotion, missing escalated ancestor-descendant pairs that should be rejected (bug 1803 compound defect)
Structural NCA-based resolution replaces type-tier promotion so same-parent tickets link unchanged and cross-subtree links escalate to nearest common ancestor children
is_redundant is recomputed post-resolution from resolved endpoints as an ancestor-descendant test for blocking relations only, rejecting both direct parent-child and grandparent-grandchild pairs
_get_ancestors cap of max_hops=2 truncates deep chains and causes fallback to chain root; removal with cycle guard allows correct NCA resolution at any depth
Non-blocking relations (relates_to, supersedes, etc.) retain original-pair redundancy semantics and gain no new rejections despite blocking branch changes
